name: Pass Line
summary: The main bet in craps: you win if the shooter makes the point.
howItWorks: Bet before the come-out roll. A 7 or 11 wins, a 2, 3 or 12 loses, and any other number becomes the point. Then the shooter must roll the point again before a 7. It pays even money and stays until it resolves.
tip: Once a point is set, add odds behind it: the odds bet has no house edge.

name: Don't Pass
summary: The opposite of the Pass Line: you win if the shooter sevens out.
howItWorks: Bet before the come-out roll. A 2 or 3 wins, a 7 or 11 loses, and a 12 is a push (the bar 12). Once a point is set, you win if a 7 rolls before the point. It pays even money.
tip: Once a point is set this bet is the favourite, so keep it up.

name: Come
summary: A Pass Line bet you can make on any roll after the point is set.
howItWorks: The next roll acts as a come-out for this bet: 7 or 11 wins, 2, 3 or 12 loses, and any other number moves your bet there to become its own point. Then it wins if that number repeats before a 7.
tip: Add odds to a Come bet once it has moved to a number.

name: Don't Come
summary: A Don't Pass bet you can make on any roll after the point is set.
howItWorks: The next roll acts as a come-out against you: 2 or 3 wins, 7 or 11 loses, 12 is a push. Any other number moves your bet there, and it wins if a 7 rolls before that number.

name: Pass Odds
summary: An extra bet behind your Pass Line bet that pays true odds.
howItWorks: After a point is set, back your Pass Line bet with odds. It wins if the point is rolled before a 7 and pays 2:1 on 4 and 10, 3:2 on 5 and 9, and 6:5 on 6 and 8. The house has no edge on it.
tip: Take as much odds as you are comfortable with. Bet in even amounts on 5 and 9, and in $5 units on 6 and 8, to get the full payout.

name: Don't Pass Odds
summary: Extra money behind a Don't Pass bet that pays true odds.
howItWorks: You lay more than you win: 1:2 against 4 and 10, 2:3 against 5 and 9, 5:6 against 6 and 8. It wins if a 7 rolls before the point, and it is always working. The house has no edge on it.
tip: Lay in units of $2 on 4 and 10, $3 on 5 and 9, and $6 on 6 and 8.

name: Come Odds
summary: Odds behind a Come bet that has moved to a number.
howItWorks: Once a Come bet has travelled to a number, back it with odds at true payouts. By default the odds are off on a come-out roll, so a 7 on the come-out returns them instead of losing them.

name: Don't Come Odds
summary: Lay odds behind a Don't Come bet that has moved to a number.
howItWorks: Once a Don't Come bet has moved to a number, lay true odds behind it. It wins if a 7 rolls before that number and is always working, even on a come-out roll.

name: Place 4
summary: A bet that the 4 rolls before a 7.
howItWorks: Pick the number and bet it rolls before a 7. It pays 9:5, a little less than true odds, so the house keeps a small edge. It is off on the come-out by default, stays up after a win, and you can take it down any time.
tip: Consider buying the 4 for $20 or more instead: the commission is cheaper than the place payout shortfall.

name: Place 5
summary: A bet that the 5 rolls before a 7.
howItWorks: Pick the number and bet it rolls before a 7. It pays 7:5, a little less than true odds, so the house keeps a small edge. It is off on the come-out by default, stays up after a win, and you can take it down any time.
tip: Bet in $5 units. A Come bet with odds is usually cheaper.

howItWorks: Pick the number and bet it rolls before a 7. It pays 7:6, a little less than true odds, so the house keeps a small edge. It is off on the come-out by default, stays up after a win, and you can take it down any time.
tip: A good bet. Bet in $6 units so the 7:6 payout comes out in whole dollars.

name: Buy 4
summary: Like Place 4, but at true odds with a commission.
howItWorks: Bet the 4 rolls before a 7. It pays true odds of 2:1, and the casino takes a 5% commission (the vig) only when you win, rounded down to whole dollars with a $1 minimum. It is off on the come-out by default.
tip: Buy for $20 or more so the $1 minimum vig is a small share of the bet. Buying the 4 and 10 beats placing them.

name: Buy 5
summary: Like Place 5, but at true odds with a commission.
howItWorks: Bet the 5 rolls before a 7. It pays true odds of 3:2, and the casino takes a 5% commission (the vig) only when you win, rounded down to whole dollars with a $1 minimum. It is off on the come-out by default.
tip: Buy for $20 or more. Buying is cheaper than placing the 5, but a Come bet with odds is cheaper still.

howItWorks: Bet the 6 rolls before a 7. It pays true odds of 6:5, and the casino takes a 5% commission (the vig) only when you win, rounded down to whole dollars with a $1 minimum. It is off on the come-out by default.
tip: Placing the 6 is cheaper than buying it. Place it instead.

name: Lay 4
summary: A bet that a 7 rolls before the 4.
howItWorks: You bet against the 4, so you risk more than you win: it pays 1:2. The casino takes 5% of your win as the vig, rounded down to whole dollars with a $1 minimum. It is always working, including on the come-out.
tip: Lay $40 for the cleanest vig. Don't Come with lay odds is cheaper.

summary: A bet that a 7 rolls before the 5.
howItWorks: You bet against the 5, so you risk more than you win: it pays 2:3. The casino takes 5% of your win as the vig, rounded down to whole dollars with a $1 minimum. It is always working, including on the come-out.
tip: Lay $30 for the cleanest vig. Don't Come with lay odds is cheaper.

name: Field
summary: A one-roll bet on 2, 3, 4, 9, 10, 11 or 12.
howItWorks: Wins if the next roll is 2, 3, 4, 9, 10, 11 or 12, and loses on 5, 6, 7 or 8. Most numbers pay even money; 2 and 12 pay double at this table. It looks like seven numbers against four, but the losing numbers are the most common ones.
tip: Because it is decided every roll, its cost adds up fast.

name: Big 6
summary: Wins when 6 rolls before a 7, but pays only even money.
howItWorks: This is the same bet as Place 6, with a worse payout of 1:1 instead of 7:6. Place the 6 instead.
tip: There is never a reason to bet Big 6: Place 6 wins on the same rolls.

name: Big 8
summary: Wins when 8 rolls before a 7, but pays only even money.
howItWorks: This is the same bet as Place 8, with a worse payout of 1:1 instead of 7:6. Place the 8 instead.
tip: There is never a reason to bet Big 8: Place 8 wins on the same rolls.

name: Hard 4
summary: Bet the 4 rolls as a pair before an easy 4 or a 7.
howItWorks: Wins if the 4 rolls the hard way (2-2) before it rolls any other way or a 7. It pays 7:1. It is off on the come-out by default, and it is a sucker bet.
tip: Tempting payouts, but the house edge is 9% or more.

name: Hard 6
summary: Bet the 6 rolls as a pair before an easy 6 or a 7.
howItWorks: Wins if the 6 rolls the hard way (3-3) before it rolls any other way or a 7. It pays 9:1. It is off on the come-out by default, and it is a sucker bet.
tip: Tempting payouts, but the house edge is 9% or more.

name: Hard 8
summary: Bet the 8 rolls as a pair before an easy 8 or a 7.
howItWorks: Wins if the 8 rolls the hard way (4-4) before it rolls any other way or a 7. It pays 9:1. It is off on the come-out by default, and it is a sucker bet.
tip: Tempting payouts, but the house edge is 9% or more.

name: Hard 10
summary: Bet the 10 rolls as a pair before an easy 10 or a 7.
howItWorks: Wins if the 10 rolls the hard way (5-5) before it rolls any other way or a 7. It pays 7:1. It is off on the come-out by default, and it is a sucker bet.
tip: Tempting payouts, but the house edge is 9% or more.

name: Any 7
summary: A one-roll bet that the next roll is a 7.
howItWorks: Wins if the next roll is a 7 and pays 4:1. Every other roll loses. It has the highest house edge on the table.
tip: The worst bet on the table. Pay your money to the casino some other way.

name: Any Craps
summary: A one-roll bet that the next roll is 2, 3 or 12.
howItWorks: Wins if the next roll is 2, 3 or 12 and pays 7:1. Every other roll loses.

name: Yo (11)
summary: A one-roll bet that the next roll is 11.
howItWorks: Wins if the next roll is 11 and pays 15:1. Everything else loses. Called "yo" so it is not mistaken for a 7.

name: Aces (2)
summary: A one-roll bet that the next roll is 2, "snake eyes".
howItWorks: Wins if the next roll is double ones and pays 30:1. Everything else loses.

name: Boxcars (12)
summary: A one-roll bet that the next roll is 12.
howItWorks: Wins if the next roll is double sixes and pays 30:1. Everything else loses.

name: Ace-Deuce (3)
summary: A one-roll bet that the next roll is 3.
howItWorks: Wins if the next roll is a 3 and pays 15:1. Everything else loses.

name: Horn
summary: Four one-roll bets at once: 2, 3, 11 and 12.
howItWorks: Bet in multiples of 4: one unit rides on each of 2, 3, 11 and 12. Whichever hits pays at its own odds, and the other three units lose.
tip: Four props in one: four times the cost.

name: Craps & Eleven
summary: A one-roll bet split between Any Craps and 11.
howItWorks: Bet in multiples of 2: half on Any Craps, half on 11. A craps number pays 3:1 on the whole bet and 11 pays 7:1. Anything else loses.

name: World (Whirl)
summary: A one-roll bet on the Horn plus Any 7.
howItWorks: Bet in multiples of 5: the Horn plus a unit on Any 7. A 7 is a push because the any-7 unit covers the others; 2, 3, 11 and 12 pay as in the Horn, less the Any 7 unit (12 nets +$26 on $5).

name: Fire Bet
summary: A bonus bet that the shooter makes 4, 5 or 6 different points before sevening out.
howItWorks: Place it before a new shooter's first come-out roll, for the prop minimum. Each distinct point the shooter makes lights a pip (making the same point twice counts once). When the shooter sevens out it pays 24 to 1 for 4 points or 249 to 1 for 5; the 6th point pays 999 to 1 at once. It cannot be taken down.
tip: About 1 hand in 100 reaches 4 points; the house edge is 20.76%. Treat it as a lottery ticket, not a strategy.

name: Small
summary: A bonus bet that 2, 3, 4, 5 and 6 all roll before a 7.
howItWorks: Place it before a new shooter's first come-out roll. Every 7 loses it, come-out rolls included. It pays 34 to 1 the moment the last of the five numbers rolls, then comes down.
tip: It hits 2.64% of the time; at 34 to 1 the house edge is 7.76% (18.3% where it pays only 30 to 1).

name: Tall
summary: A bonus bet that 8, 9, 10, 11 and 12 all roll before a 7.
howItWorks: Place it before a new shooter's first come-out roll. Every 7 loses it, come-out rolls included. It pays 34 to 1 the moment the last of the five numbers rolls, then comes down.
tip: Same odds as Small: 2.64% to hit, 7.76% house edge at 34 to 1.

name: All
summary: A bonus bet that every number from 2 to 12 except 7 rolls before a 7.
howItWorks: Place it before a new shooter's first come-out roll. Every 7 loses it. It pays 175 to 1 the moment the tenth number rolls, then comes down.
tip: It hits 0.53% of the time; at 175 to 1 the house edge is 7.46% (20.6% at 150 to 1).
